package.name: @chenyqthu/tp-mobile-ui-kit
package.description: TP-Link multi-brand mobile React UI component library (TP-Design 10-mode Theme Engine + Omada APP 5.3 Blocks & Real PAG Motion Assets + Single-file HTML standalone bundle)

components.name: resolveRuntimeAssetUrl
components.description: Resolves asset URLs across Vite dev server, ESM chunk imports, and standalone zero-build HTML bundles.

components.name: TPBrandLogo
components.description: Official TP-Link app & product brand mark (Omada, Tapo, Tether, Deco, Mercusys, VIGI, Aginet, etc.).

components.name: TPIcon
components.description: Renders TP-Design & Omada mobile Figma icons. Monochrome SVG icons inherit `currentColor`.

components.name: TPIllustration
components.description: Light/Dark aware mobile illustration component. Auto-follows `useTPTheme().resolvedMode` with fallback to Light.

components.name: TPMotion
components.description: Plays authentic TP-Link Tencent `.pag` animation files via `libpag` WASM, automatically matching Light/Dark theme and degrading gracefully without WebGL (e.g. jsdom).

props.name: useCanvas2D
props.description: Shares libpag global WebGL context across instances (prevents browser WebGL context exhaustion).

components.name: TPBadge
components.description: Count or dot indicator badge, standalone or anchored to top-right of wrapped children.

components.name: TPDatePicker
components.description: Mobile date wheel picker with Year / Month / Day columns, leap-year clamping, and header actions.

components.name: TPDaySwitcher
components.description: 7-day circular/pill toggle strip supporting English and Chinese weekday labels.

components.name: TPEmptyState
components.description: Empty state layout integrating theme-aware TPIllustration or custom icon plus optional CTA button.

components.name: TPInput
components.description: Form input supporting labels, controlled/uncontrolled value, clearable button, password visibility toggle, helper/error text, prefix/suffix, and multiline mode.

components.name: TPKeyboard
components.description: Mobile keypad supporting numeric, PIN, and MAC-address hexadecimal input modes.

components.name: TPListButton
components.description: Full-width action button styled as a grouped list row.

components.name: TPListCard
components.description: Grouped card container for mobile list rows and settings sections.

components.name: TPListItem
components.description: Standard mobile list row supporting leading media, multi-line titles, value/badge/switch/arrow trailing slots.

components.name: TPSearchBar
components.description: Mobile pill search bar with magnifying glass icon, clear button, and optional Cancel action.

components.name: TPSectionHeader
components.description: Muted section header placed above grouped list cards.

components.name: TPSectionNote
components.description: Helper/caption footer note placed beneath grouped cards or form fields.

components.name: TPTag
components.description: Pill chip/tag supporting selected filter state, semantic tones, and optional close button.

components.name: TPText
components.description: Token-driven typography primitive aligned with TP-Design brand font weights and semantic tones.

components.name: TPTimePicker
components.description: Mobile time wheel picker supporting 24-hour and 12-hour (AM/PM) modes plus custom minute steps.

props.name: onChange
props.type: (val: { hour: number; minute: number; period?: 'AM' | 'PM' }) => void

components.name: TPWheelPicker
components.description: Multi-column scrollable/clickable wheel picker with centered highlight band and keyboard/step controls.

components.name: TPButton
components.description: Brand-adaptive button respecting --tp-radius-btn and secondary outline/fill tokens; uses variant= and htmlType= (never type=).

components.name: TPFixedButtonBar
components.description: Sticky bottom action footer supporting single, dual-horizontal, and dual-vertical button layouts with optional note.

components.name: TPHeader
components.description: Mobile navigation header supporting standard docked bar and Omada floating glass action wells with dropdown title, subtitle, and rightBadge.

components.name: TPPageControl
components.description: Carousel/onboarding pagination dot indicator with optional interactive step selection.

components.name: TPPhoneFrame
components.description: Device preview shell supporting iphone16pro, iphone14, android, and compact presets with statusBar, floatingAction, bottomBar, Dynamic Island, and Home Indicator.

components.name: TPSegment
components.description: Segmented tab switcher supporting full-width/auto underline tabs and rounded pill track variants.

components.name: TPSlider
components.description: Range slider driven by --tp-slider-stroke and --tp-slider-tick with optional marks, unit, and live value header.

components.name: TPStatusBar
components.description: Platform-adaptive iOS/Android status bar with time, mute/location indicators, signal bars, Wi-Fi icon, and battery gauge.

components.name: TPSwitch
components.description: Accessible role="switch" toggle driven by --tp-focus with controlled/uncontrolled, disabled, and loading states.

components.name: TPTabBar
components.description: Bottom navigation tab bar supporting iOS frosted floating-pill and docked modes with TPIcon strings or custom nodes and badges.

components.name: TPActionSheet
components.description: Platform-adaptive action sheet (iOS floating grouped cards vs Android bottom sheet) supporting rich options, icons, and destructive role.

components.name: TPAlert
components.description: Platform-adaptive modal alert dialog (frosted centered iOS dialog vs Material Android dialog) with optional inline prompt input.

components.name: TPBottomSheet
components.description: Draggable-style modal bottom sheet with grabber, title/subtitle, close button, scrollable body, and sticky footer.

components.name: TPMenu
components.description: Floating dropdown menu card anchored left, right, or center with selection checkmarks, icons, dividers, and danger tone.

components.name: TPPopup
components.description: Generic overlay popup dialog supporting center, top, and bottom placements.

components.name: TPPrompt
components.description: Inline announcement banner supporting info, focus, warning, and alert tones with optional action CTA and dismiss button.

components.name: TPToast
components.description: Non-blocking toast notification supporting default, info, success, warning, error, and loading spinners.

components.name: TPToastProvider
components.description: Context provider mounting global TPToast notifications for useTPToast().

components.name: useTPToast
components.description: Hook returning { show, dismiss } to trigger imperative TPToast notifications.

components.name: OmadaDeviceListBlock
components.description: Reusable Omada v5.3+ Device List block matching real-device `SiteDevices.png` row geometry.

components.name: OmadaIncidentsBlock
components.description: Reusable Omada v5.3+ Logs / Alerts & Events block with severity filtering and Mark All Read.

components.name: OmadaWirelessNetworkBlock
components.description: Reusable Omada v5.3+ Wireless Network (WLAN/SSID) configuration block with IP/MAC ACL and `deploy-config` PAG motion.

components.name: OmadaDeviceThumb
components.description: Device thumbnail icon helper rendering Omada access point, switch, or gateway icons.

components.name: OmadaStandardInput
components.description: Figma `【Omada】Standard Input` supporting segmented IPv4 (`0-255`), segmented MAC (`8C-86-DD-A6-A7-5F`), port, and text fields.

components.name: OmadaAppDemo
components.description: Interactive end-to-end Omada APP v5.3–6.3 prototype wiring all 7 real-device screens and drill-down sub-pages inside `TPPhoneFrame`.

components.name: OmadaControllerListPage
components.description: 1:1 restoration of `controllerlist.png`: green `C` avatar, `All Systems` TPMenu filter, `+` add button, `TPSearchBar`, `Cloud Management (5)` section header, and all 5 real Omada controllers.

components.name: OmadaDeviceDetailPage
components.description: Full Device Detail screen supporting Overview (with `update-network` Firmware Upgrade sheet), interactive Ports grid (playing `port-card-expand` PAG motion), and Config (`OmadaStandardInput` IP/MAC/Port).

components.name: OmadaHealthDetailPage
components.description: Drill-down Site Health Score detail screen with radial score gauge, subsystem metrics, and 24-hour historical health chart.

components.name: OmadaLaunchLoadingPage
components.description: 1:1 restoration of `launchloading.png`: floating glass header, blue dismissible upgrade prompt, 3 animated skeleton dashboard cards, green Toolkit FAB, and floating glass TabBar.

components.name: OmadaSiteClientsPage
components.description: 1:1 restoration of `SiteClients.png`: floating `Clients` header with `Filter | ⋮` glass capsule, live `TPSearchBar`, `Online | Offline | Blocked | All` underline segment, `All | Wired | Wireless` chips, and all 4 real clients with color-coded dBm RSSI metrics.

components.name: OmadaSiteDashboardPage
components.description: 1:1 restoration of `siteDashboard.png`: floating site selector header (`92 ⌄ / 62`, log badge `1`), 4 KPI tiles + Topology CTA, Site Health Score (`100` + 3 subcards + timeline scrubber), ISP Activity (`SFP WAN/LAN1`, `WAN3`), Internet Activity dual-series chart, Toolkit FAB, and floating TabBar.

components.name: OmadaSiteDevicesPage
components.description: 1:1 restoration of `SiteDevices.png`: floating `Devices` header with `+ | ⋮` glass capsule, live `TPSearchBar`, `Device List | Device Group` underline segment, expandable filter chips, `OmadaDeviceListBlock`, and floating TabBar.

components.name: OmadaSiteInsightsPage
components.description: 1:1 restoration of `SiteInsights.png`: floating `Insights` header with calendar range button, 4 underline tabs (`Wired`, `Wireless`, `Client`, `Apps`), `ISP Load` dual-axis histogram + latency pulse, `WAN Health Trend`, `Gateway Utilization`, and `Switch Health Trend`.

components.name: OmadaSiteSettingsPage
components.description: 1:1 restoration of `SiteSettings.png`: centered `Settings` header, live `TPSearchBar`, 4 grouped `TPListCard`s with exact Omada `settings-*` icons, and drill-downs to Wireless Networks & Logs.

components.name: TP_BRANDS
components.description: Metadata array of the 6 supported TP-Design brands (omada, tapo, tether, mercusys, deco, ux).

components.name: TP_THEME_PRESETS
components.description: Complete 12-mode (6 brands x light/dark) TP-Design variable preset dictionary.

components.name: TPThemeContext
components.description: React context powering TPThemeProvider and useTPTheme.

components.name: TPThemeProvider
components.description: Multi-brand TP-Design theme provider supporting 6 brands, light/dark/system modes, iOS/Android OS styles, and scoped attributes.

props.name: scoped
props.description: When true, applies theme attributes only on the wrapper element instead of `document.documentElement`.

components.name: useTPTheme
components.description: Hook returning current brand, color mode, resolvedMode, os, screenSize, theme tokens, and theme setters.

templates.title: Omada Site Dashboard & Interactive App Shell
templates.summary: Full Omada APP v5.3–6.3 mobile prototype using OmadaAppDemo & OmadaSiteDashboardPage inside TPPhoneFrame with live site switching, Light/Dark toggle, Toolkit diagnostics sheet, and floating pill TPTabBar.

templates.title: Multi-Brand TP-Design 12-Mode Theme Showcase
templates.summary: Interactive 6-brand switcher (omada, tapo, tether, mercusys, deco, ux) + Light/Dark/OS mode + iOS/Android toggle showing automatic corner radius, secondary button stroke/fill, slider tick, typography, TPBrandLogo, TPIllustration, TPAlert, and TPToast adaptation.

templates.title: Omada Device Detail + Real PAG Motion & Config
templates.summary: Mobile device inspector combining OmadaDeviceDetailPage, interactive port grid with real Tencent PAG port-card-expand motion, firmware upgrade update-network PAG sheet, and segmented IPv4/MAC/Port OmadaStandardInput.

recipes.title: Zero-Build Single-File HTML Prototype
recipes.summary: Classic <script> tags loading dist/style.css + dist/standalone.js + @babel/standalone so file:// double-click works without CORS or Vite.

recipes.title: 6-Brand TP-Design + Light/Dark/System + iOS/Android Switching
recipes.summary: Wrap root UI in <TPThemeProvider defaultBrand="omada" defaultMode="light" defaultOS="ios"> and read/mutate via useTPTheme().

recipes.title: Omada APP v5.3–6.3 7-Screen Mobile Prototype
recipes.summary: Mount <OmadaAppDemo /> or individual pages (OmadaLaunchLoadingPage, OmadaControllerListPage, OmadaSiteDashboardPage, OmadaSiteInsightsPage, OmadaSiteDevicesPage, OmadaSiteClientsPage, OmadaSiteSettingsPage) inside TPPhoneFrame.

recipes.title: Tencent PAG (.pag) Vector Motion Integration
recipes.summary: Render <TPMotion name="port-card-expand" /> or <TPMotion name="update-network" /> backed by libpag WASM (public/libpag.wasm with jsDelivr CDN fallback and SVG fallback).
